headline: Result Update

highlights: 17 November 2026 CMP*: ₹1,010/- Sector – Healthcare Max Healthcare Institute Ltd – Q2FY27 1 Result Update Q2FY27 Max Healthcare Institute Ltd Important Data • During Q2FY27, Max Healthcare reported healthy revenue growth, with gross revenue increasing 20% YoY and 8% QoQ to ₹3,219crs.
Net revenue grew 18% YoY to ₹3,055crs, supported by higher patient volumes and improved realisations.
Gross profit increased 19% YoY to ₹1,814crs, while gross margin remained stable at 59%.
Operating EBITDA grew 18% YoY to ₹820crs, with margins remaining stable at 27%, despite a 20% increase in indirect overheads.
valuation: At the current market price, the stock trades at 43x FY28E EPS of ₹22 and 27x FY28E EV/EBITDA.
Given the strong growth prospects, which are largely reflected in the current valuation, we maintain our Hold rating.
watch: Overall performance was supported by higher patient volumes, improved ARPP and healthy growth across key specialties.
This material contains statements that are forward-looking; such statements are based upon the current beliefs and expectations and are subject to significant risks and uncertainties.
